question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Microsoft)

calls.reasoning: Microsoft guided FQ1'27 (Sep-2026 qtr) revenue $89.85-90.95B (mid 90.4B); consensus ~90.6-90.7B. Over the last 4 quarters MSFT beat guidance midpoint by ~1.5-3.2% (FQ3'26 82.9 vs 81.25 mid; FQ4'26 90.0 vs ~87.3; FQ1'26 77.7 vs 76.05; FQ2'26 81.3 vs 80.05). Applying ~2.2% median beat gives ~92.4B. Azure guided to 45% cc growth with upward revisions to Intelligent Cloud; FX is a modest swing factor. Below 90.2B requires a miss of guidance midpoint (rare); above 94.5B requires ~4.5% beat. No prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold.

calls.reconciliation: No factual conflicts: all three runs agree on guidance $89.85-90.95B, consensus ~$90.6-90.7B, a report date of Oct 28, and beats over the guidance midpoint of about +1.2B to +2.75B. The ChartMill figure of $92.45B is likely stale or defined differently; it can't be settled without web access, and it isn't load-bearing. The remaining disagreement is judgment: whether to apply the median % beat (Run 1, ~92.35B) or discount for lumpy Q4 items (Run 3, ~91.9B). Guidance already rebases off the Q4 level, and the % beats were fairly stable at ~1.6-2.2% outside Q4, so I centre on ~2% (92.2B). I carry forward the runs' reference class and a dispersion of ~2.3B (as in Run 2). I retrieved nothing new on this run.
